# obsei

> obsei is open source, privacy-first Voice of Customer analytics: a self-hosted alternative to Enterpret and Unwrap that strips PII from feedback before any LLM sees it.

obsei collects customer feedback from reviews, tickets, surveys and communities, redacts personal data and pseudonymizes authors at ingest, classifies it with your own models, routes it to sinks such as Slack, Jira or a webhook, and serves it to AI agents through an MCP server whose only write, a proposed issue, waits for human approval. It is a Python package (`pip install obsei`) configured with `obsei.yaml` and run with the `obsei` CLI. Apache-2.0.

## Docs

- [Full docs for LLMs](https://docs.obsei.com/llms-full.txt): every docs page in one file
- [Quickstart](https://docs.obsei.com/quickstart/): install, sample data, first run, Docker
- [MCP and agents](https://docs.obsei.com/guides/mcp/): connect Claude, Cursor and other clients
- [Use obsei as the privacy step for your agent](https://docs.obsei.com/guides/agents/): what agents can see and copy-paste prompts
- [Configuration](https://docs.obsei.com/configuration/): the `obsei.yaml` reference
